seoTitle: Consent Mode gcs and gcd Decoder: Read Google Consent State
metaDescription: Paste Google tag request URLs and decode the gcs and gcd parameters into ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization.
intro: Decodes the gcs and gcd parameters from Google tag requests to show the consent state of each signal.
why:
When you debug Consent Mode you look at network requests and see values like gcs=G101 or gcd=13r3r3q3q5. They are hard to read by eye.

This tool extracts both parameters from a URL or a pasted value and spells out each signal. The gcs form is the original one. Google does not publish the gcd format, so the letter table comes from third-party documentation and may change. Use it as a debugging aid and confirm with Google's own tools when it matters.
howTo: Open dev tools, Network tab, and find a request to a Google domain such as google-analytics.com/g/collect.
Paste it, or just the gcs and gcd values, one per line.
Read the state for each signal.

faq.q: Why is gcd not officially documented?
faq.a: Google has not published the format. The mapping used here comes from CookieHub documentation and may be incomplete.

faq.q: What does a letter like r mean?
faq.a: Denied by default, then granted by an update call. Other letters are listed in the output.

faq.q: Does it need the whole URL?
faq.a: No. A value like gcd=13r3r3q3q5 is enough.
